name: clean_pass
note: The contract's example worksheet: D4 7,620, D6 5,334, E7 5,200 — every rule passes (G7 yes: another lender).

name: f3_owner_fail_with_other_debts
note: N$5,000 repays 6,500 > limit 5,334: F3 fails, and with another lender (b5) G8 fails too — both owner-class.

name: f3_fail_no_other_debts_g8_pass
note: Only our own balance (b8) and no other lender: G7 no, so G8 passes even though F3 fails.

name: g8_other_debt_b11_only
note: Any of b1–b7/b9–b11 counts as another lender (here b11 only): G7 yes; F3 passes so G8 passes.

name: d4_negative_hard_fail
note: Living costs leave −N$340: D4 hard fail, D6 0, F3/G8 fail, F5 0.

name: d4_zero_boundary
note: D4 exactly 0 is not above zero: hard fail.

name: docs_missing
note: Bank statement month 1 (2.3) not examined: DOCS hard fail. 2.6/2.7 are not required.

name: g1_charges_above_cap
note: Service fee N$50 on top of 30% interest: charges 1,250 > 30% of 4,000 → G1 hard fail.

name: g1_tolerance_pass
note: 333.33 at 30%: E2 rounds to 100.00, a hair above 99.999 but within the 0.005 tolerance → G1 passes.

name: g2_above_max_principal
note: N$120,000 is above the N$100,000 maximum: G2 hard fail (and far above the limit).

name: g3_over_five_months
note: Due 2027-03-01 is after 2027-02-28 (issue + 5 months): G3 hard fail.

name: g3_month_end_clamp
note: Issue 30 Sep + 5 months = 28 Feb 2027 (month end clamps). Due 1 Mar 2027 fails G3.

name: g3_month_end_clamp_pass
note: Issue 30 Sep, due 28 Feb 2027: exactly 5 months (clamped) → G3 passes.

name: g3_due_not_after_issue
note: Due date equal to the issue date: G3 hard fail, E10 = 0.

name: g3_missing_dates
note: No dates yet (draft): E10 null, G3 fails.

name: bureau_required_without_report
note: Policy requires the bureau and none is recorded: G4 hard fail.

name: bureau_required_with_report
note: Policy requires the bureau; used, date and ref recorded: G4 passes.

name: irregular_income_uses_a11
note: Irregular income: A6 is the lowest month (a11 = 15,000), not the lower of A4 and A5.

name: flags_at_threshold
note: Two warning signs (8.3, 8.5) reach the threshold of 2: FLAGS soft fail.

name: verify_false
note: 2.9: the bank account is not the payout account → VERIFY soft fail.

name: g9_no
note: Salary deductions over one third (G9 'no'): soft fail.

name: g5_g6_soft_fails
note: No bureau consent (G5) and no bank account number (G6): soft fails.

name: g10_g11_hard_fail
note: Compulsory insurance (G10) and a card held (G11): hard fails.

name: f5_zero_fee_above_limit
note: D6 (70) is not above the service fee (100): F5 = 0.

name: f5_capped_at_max_principal
note: Very high income: floor(198,289 / 1.3 / 50) × 50 = 152,500, capped at the N$100,000 maximum.

name: policy_custom
note: Other policy values flow through: D5 50%, rate 25%, step N$100, cap 25%, 3 months, threshold 3.
